name: paradice

phase_0.boundary_condition: The Hilbert space limit defining the observable universe of the paradox

VINIT.justification: The state before any wave function is defined or any observation is possible

TANCH.justification: The total probability sum of one that contains all possible outcomes

AFWD.justification: The forward propagation of the wave function through time

AREV.justification: The mathematical inversion of the evolution operator to recover previous states

CLINK.justification: The sequential application of quantum gates to a state

IMSCRIB.justification: A state that remains itself under the action of a specific operator

FSPLIT.justification: A single state branching into a linear combination of mutually exclusive basis states

FFUSE.justification: The recombination of paths to recover the original coherent state

EVALT.justification: The affirmative reinforcement of the probability amplitude

EVALF.justification: The negative cancellation of the probability amplitude

ENGAGR.justification: The simultaneous occupation of contradictory states held in coherent tension

IFIX.justification: The irreversible reduction of the superposition into a single classical record

phase_3.void_description: The absence of any quantum field or potential
phase_3.true_description: The realization of the primary state vector
phase_3.false_description: The realization of the orthogonal state vector
phase_3.both_description: The coherent superposition where both vectors exist as a single entity

steps.domain_action: Establish the vacuum potential for the paradox
Identify the base state of the system
Evolve the state toward the interaction point
Branch the state into a superposition of possibilities
Anchor the affirmative path of the superposition
Anchor the negative path of the superposition
Hold both paths in a state of paradice without resolution
Compose the resulting state with the observer system
Record the final measurement as a permanent classical fact
Close the system boundary at the measurement horizon

phase_5.compiler_frontend: The Hamiltonian governing the energy transitions of the system
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: Quantum entanglement linking disparate parts of the state
phase_5.memory_mechanism: The phase information stored within the wave function
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: The Planck constant determining the scale of action
phase_5.alfs_store: The universal wave function as the primary data store

phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — The unitary evolution preserves information until the final fixation
